title: MR-Guided Focused Ultrasound for Anti-PD-1 Delivery in Glioblastoma
pi: Dr. Aisha Patel, Johns Hopkins University
abstract: Recurrent glioblastoma has a median survival under nine months. Anti-PD-1 immunotherapy works in other cancers but the blood-brain barrier (BBB) blocks it from reaching brain tumors. We propose using MR-guided focused ultrasound (FUS) with circulating microbubbles to temporarily open the BBB, allowing anti-PD-1 to reach the tumor. 12-month preclinical mouse study. Budget: $99,000.

ground_truth.rationale: Uses focused ultrasound centrally to treat a priority disease (glioblastoma), with two priority mechanisms (drug delivery + immunomodulation). Realistic budget and timeline.

title: Lipid Nanoparticle mRNA Vaccines for HER2+ Breast Cancer
pi: Dr. Yuki Tanaka, Memorial Sloan Kettering
abstract: Metastatic HER2+ breast cancer remains lethal despite advances in immunotherapy. We propose a precision drug delivery platform: lipid nanoparticles carrying HER2-targeted mRNA vaccines for targeted immunomodulation of the tumor microenvironment. The mRNA payload also encodes gene therapy elements to enhance T-cell priming. 12-month preclinical mouse study; strong vaccine and oncology team. Budget: $99,000.

ground_truth.rationale: The disease (breast cancer) and mechanism (immunotherapy) are FUSF priorities, but the project does not use focused ultrasound at all — delivery is via lipid nanoparticles. Fails FUSF's mission core.
